ctaHeading: Brunswick's cabinet makers are ready — let's bring your vision to life.
aboutText: WOODBEAST is Brunswick's go-to for custom cabinetry and fine joinery. Based on Florence St, we design and build bespoke pieces that transform kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces across Melbourne's inner north. From solid timber benchtops to fitted wardrobes, every WOODBEAST creation is crafted with precision, passion, and the kind of detail only a true Brunswick maker can deliver.
servicesText: From kitchen overhauls to complete bathroom fit-outs, WOODBEAST delivers handcrafted cabinetry tailored to your Brunswick home. Every piece is designed in consultation with you and built in our Florence St workshop using quality Australian timbers and a keen eye for detail.

services.title: Custom Kitchen Cabinetry
services.desc: Bespoke kitchen cabinets, benchtops, and island units designed and built to fit your exact space and style.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Handcrafted vanities and shaving cabinets that combine smart storage with beautiful timber finishes.

services.title: Built-in Wardrobes
services.desc: Floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes with custom interiors, optimising every centimetre of your bedroom.

services.title: Entertainment Units
services.desc: Custom media consoles and shelving units designed to house your gear and match your living space.

services.title: Custom Joinery
services.desc: One-off timber pieces including shelving, study nooks, and storage solutions for tricky spaces.

services.title: Kitchen Renovations
services.desc: Full kitchen refits from design through to installation, giving your Brunswick home a fresh new heart.
